=== branches forward and back
start:
        bt      next
        nop
next:   bf      start
        bra     start
        nop
        bsr     next
        nop
=== local labels
1:      dt      r1
        bf      1b
        bt/s    2f
        nop
2:      rts
        nop
=== delayed conditional branches
top:    bt/s    top
        mov     r1, r2
        bf/s    end
        add     #1, r3
end:    rts
        nop
=== bra and bsr at the ends of their reach
        bra     far
        nop
        .space  4090
far:    bsr     back
        nop
        .space  4088
        .space  4
back:   nop
=== bra backward limit
back:   nop
        .space  4090
        bra     back
        nop
=== bt forward limit fits
        bt      far
        .space  254
far:    nop
=== bt forward just past the limit relaxes
        bt      far
        .space  258
far:    nop
=== bf forward relaxes to bt over bra
        bf      far
        .space  300
far:    nop
=== bt backward limit fits
far:    nop
        .space  250
        bt      far
=== bt backward just past the limit relaxes
far:    nop
        .space  252
        bt      far
=== bt/s relaxes without a nop
        bt/s    far
        mov     r1, r2
        .space  300
far:    nop
=== bf/s relaxes backward
far:    nop
        .space  400
        bf/s    far
        add     #1, r1
=== relaxation that pushes a second branch out
        bt      b
        bt      a
        .space  252
a:      nop
b:      nop
=== two branches that both stay short
        bt      a
        bt      a
        .space  250
a:      nop
=== mov.l from a literal pool, instruction on a 4-byte boundary
        mov.l   lit, r1
        jmp     @r1
        nop
        nop
lit:    .long   0x12345678
=== mov.l from a literal pool, instruction 2 bytes past a boundary
        nop
        mov.l   lit, r1
        jmp     @r1
        nop
lit:    .long   0x89abcdef
=== mova and mov.l share an aligned pool
        nop
        mova    tbl, r0
        mov.l   tbl, r2
        rts
        nop
        .balign 4
tbl:    .long   1
        .long   2
=== mov.w from a word literal
        mov.w   w1, r1
        mov.w   w2, r2
        rts
        nop
w1:     .word   0x1234
w2:     .word   -2
=== mov.l at the far end of its reach
        mov.l   lit, r0
        nop
        .space  1016
lit:    .long   7
=== mov.w at the far end of its reach
        mov.w   lit, r0
        .space  508
lit:    .word   7
=== a function with a literal pool
        .text
        .globl  func
func:
        mov.l   r14, @-r15
        sts.l   pr, @-r15
        mov     r15, r14
        mov.l   .Lstr, r4
        mov.l   .Lputs, r1
        jsr     @r1
        nop
        mov     r14, r15
        lds.l   @r15+, pr
        rts
        mov.l   @r15+, r14
        .balign 4
.Lstr:  .long   0
.Lputs: .long   0
=== alignment in code pads with nops
        nop
        .balign 4
        mov     #1, r0
        .balign 4
        nop
        nop
=== an odd pad gets a zero byte before the nops
        .byte   1
        .balign 4
        nop
        nop
        nop
        nop
=== p2align
        mov     #1, r0
        .p2align 3
        rts
        nop
        nop
        nop
=== label difference as an immediate and a displacement
        mov     #b-a, r1
        mov.l   @(b-a,r2), r3
a:      nop
        nop
b:      nop
        nop
=== equates in operands
        .equ    OFF, 8
        .set    IMM, -3
        mov.l   @(OFF,r1), r2
        mov     #IMM, r3
        mov.w   @(OFF*2,gbr), r0
        trapa   #OFF
=== deprecated @(label,pc)
        mov.l   @(lit,pc), r1
        nop
lit:    .long   5
=== the delay slot is left as written
        jsr     @r1
        mov     #0, r4
        bra     1f
        add     #1, r4
1:      rts
        mov     r4, r0
=== fpu sequence
        fldi1   fr0
        fldi0   fr1
        fadd    fr0, fr1
        fmov    fr1, @-r15
        fmov.s  @r15+, fr2
        float   fpul, fr3
        ftrc    fr3, fpul
        fschg
        fmov    dr2, dr4
        fschg
        rts
        nop
=== system register save and restore
        stc.l   sr, @-r15
        stc.l   gbr, @-r15
        stc.l   vbr, @-r15
        stc.l   ssr, @-r15
        stc.l   spc, @-r15
        sts.l   mach, @-r15
        sts.l   macl, @-r15
        lds.l   @r15+, macl
        lds.l   @r15+, mach
        ldc.l   @r15+, spc
        ldc.l   @r15+, ssr
        ldc.l   @r15+, vbr
        ldc.l   @r15+, gbr
        rte
        ldc.l   @r15+, sr
=== data after code
        mov.l   x, r0
        rts
        nop
        nop
x:      .long   0x01020304
        .word   0x0506
        .byte   7, 8
=== a relaxed branch pushes an earlier one out of reach
        bt      b
        bt      c
        .space  252
b:      nop
        .space  300
c:      nop
=== a relaxed bt/s moves a longword load to the other boundary
        nop
        bt/s    far
        nop
        mov.l   lit, r1
        nop
        .balign 4
lit:    .long   5
        .space  300
far:    nop
        nop
=== two relaxed delayed branches move a load twice
        nop
        bt/s    far
        nop
        bf/s    far
        nop
        mov.l   lit, r1
        mova    lit, r0
        .balign 4
lit:    .long   5
        .space  300
far:    nop
        nop
=== literal with an offset
        mov.l   tbl+4, r1
        mov.w   tbl+2, r2
        nop
        nop
tbl:    .long   0x11112222
        .long   0x33334444
=== a longword load two bytes past a boundary reaches 1020 bytes from pc+2
        nop
        mov.l   lit, r0
        .space  1016
lit:    .long   7
=== a longword load two bytes past a boundary reaches the very next word
        nop
        mov.l   lit, r0
lit:    .long   1
=== at 2 pc from two bytes past a boundary
        nop
        mov.l   @(2,pc), r0
        .long   5
=== a word literal at the far end of reach
        mov.w   lit, r0
        .space  508
lit:    .word   7
=== a load at an odd address takes GNU as's base
        .byte   1, 2, 3
        mova    lit, r0
        .align  2
lit:    .long   1
=== long data raises the section alignment, so the tail is padded
        .long   1
        nop
=== unaligned data spellings
        .byte   1
        .ualong 2
        .uaword 3
        .4byte  4
        .2byte  5
        .8byte  6
        .uaquad 7
=== a branch sized in order stays short when an alignment absorbed the growth
        bt      far
        nop
back:   nop
        .space  246
        .align  3
        nop
        nop
        bf      back
far:    nop
=== an earlier load and an alignment between keep a backward bf short
        mova    P1, r0
        .space  2
        mova    P2, r0
        bt      C0
        nop
        nop
C1:     nop
        .space  240
        mov.l   P0, r9
        mov.l   P2, r0
        .align  3
        bf      C1
C0:     bf      C1
P0:     .long   0x506e4f97
P1:     .long   0x8f444987
P2:     .long   0x440c7ef3
=== padding ahead of a long that the final layout does not need still sizes branches
        bf/s    C0
        mov     r1, r2
        bt/s    C0
        mov     r1, r2
        mov     r3, r4
        .long   94
        .space  200
W0:     .word   0x7a5b
        bt/s    C1
        mov     r1, r2
        bt/s    C0
        mov     r1, r2
        bra     C1
        nop
        .space  10
        .long   96
        bf      C0
        bf      C1
        mov     r3, r4
        .align  2
P0:     .long   0x77826199
P1:     .long   0xf2518742
C0:
C1:
=== growth before an alignment is not assumed to carry a label past it
        bt      far
        bt      x
        .space  256
        .align  3
x:      nop
        .space  300
far:    nop
=== a branch that growth carried past its target beyond an alignment keeps its size
far:    nop
        .space  300
        .rept   66
        bt      far
        .endr
        bf      y
        .align  2
y:      nop
